scope: Full namespaces. Default uses bounded ICU4X historical data and arithmetic for Chinese/Dangi, host Intl for Umm al-Qura, compact owned IANA timezone histories and numeric arithmetic calendars. Standalone retains full-range calendar packs with the same compact timezone histories. Legacy plain and numeric non-Gregorian formatting uses host labels and compact CLDR Before Hijrah labels. Full reference uses host Intl for calendar and timezone data. Size only; full compliance and host timezone migration remain open.
method: Bazel Rolldown bundles, esbuild es2022 minification, gzip level 9; byte lengths include newline.
